oneOf.description: DWD (German Weather Service) DX local radar sweep format in polar coordinates, used for operational weather radar products.
FURUNO SCN radar format used in WR2120/WR2100 systems for X-band radar data.
Extended FURUNO SCNX radar format providing higher precision and metadata-rich X-band datasets.
General-purpose Network Common Data Format supporting radar datasets through decoder libraries (e.g., NetCDF-Java for NEXRAD Level II/III).
OPERA-compliant BUFR radar exchange format used within EUMETNET for standardized radar reflectivity and volume data.
OPERA HDF5-based format aligned with the ODIM model for both radial and Cartesian radar products.
DWD RADOLAN compositing format for radar-based precipitation mosaics across Germany.
Digital Terrain Model used in radar processing for terrain correction and clutter mapping.
CF-compliant NetCDF radar moments format (CfRadial-1), designed for radial-coordinate weather radar data.
Next-generation CfRadial-2 NetCDF radar format supporting richer metadata and consistent CF conventions.
EuMetNet BALTRAD / OPERA ODIM HDF5 radar data model for both polar and Cartesian radar datasets.
Universal Format, a legacy but widely supported radar data format used in many historical and operational systems.
NCAR/EOL DORADE radar format used in research radars and legacy field campaigns.
Vaisala SIGMET/IRIS raw radar data format used in numerous operational weather radar networks.
NCAR/RAL MDV volumetric radar format supporting radial and Cartesian gridded weather radar products.
U.S. NOAA NEXRAD Level II radar format (Message 1/31), widely distributed through NCEI and used for operational meteorology.
